summary: Scoped production diagnostic slice export request — privacy-minimization review
description:
Issue summary: Request from Security to extract a tightly scoped set of production inference logs (a 'slice') to investigate a reported prompt redaction anomaly from a single enterprise tenant. The extraction must minimize customer-identifiable data and follow privacy minimization principles.

Impact: Security needs the slice to validate whether a model/serving runtime change correlated with increased exposure of masked fields. Customers are not currently impacted broadly, but the tenant reported potential PII in outputs. This is time-sensitive for the incident triage.

Request details: Export up to 10k inference events for tenant 'NovaPayments' spanning 2026-02-20 to 2026-02-25, filtered to routes: /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate. The export should include: timestamp, request_id, model_version, route, truncated prompt (first 512 chars), truncated response (first 1024 chars), redaction flags, and system metadata (region, node id). All raw user inputs must be redacted or token-hashed unless explicitly approved.

Justification: Security triage and legal evidence for a customer service escalation. The data will be used only by SRE and Security engineers listed in the approver list.

Required approvals: Privacy (Legal), Security, and SRE lead. Proposed mitigations: PII-hash all user input fields, mask token IDs, limit export storage to 7 days, provide access via ephemeral SAM role with recorded session.

Deliverable format: compressed CSV with column schema in Confluence. Access method: temporary S3 bucket with KMS encryption and object lifecycle.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Identify tenant id for NovaPayments in customer tenants service.
2. Run log query on prod-logs partition for 2026-02-20..2026-02-25 filtering by tenant_id and routes /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate.
3. Truncate prompt/response fields at export time and apply token-hash to full_text fields.
4. Place export in encrypted S3 with lifecycle 7 days and grant ephemeral role to approvers only.
logs: query_hint: tenant_id='nova-payments' AND (route='/v1/chat/stream' OR route='/v1/generate') AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-02-25'
investigation_notes: 2026-03-02 — SRE: initial sampling run returned 9,842 events before redaction. Identified 3 events with unmasked email-like strings in assistant response. Saved sample id: sample-INT-13521-1.

2026-03-03 — Security: hypothesis that a custom system instruction override in tenant config bypassed content redaction during a short rollout window (2026-02-21 03:15-03:45 UTC). Need to correlate rollout traces with serving runtime version tags.
2026-03-04 — Privacy: recommended hashing all user_input fields and removing full_text fields except truncated versions; requested Legal review for data retention beyond 7 days.
2026-03-06 — SRE: prepared export script with redaction hooks; dry run performed on staging logs, script id: export-sim-42. Dry run produced expected masked outputs from staging.
2026-03-07 — Note: linked INT-12456 (temp-restricted-query-access) for precedence on limited query approvals and INT-7624 for masked-prod-log-access policy reference.
comments: Aisha Rahman (2026-03-01): Opening request — marking as P1 due to security triage need. Adding Privacy, Security, and SRE as approvers.

Priya Shah - Privacy (2026-03-02): Please provide justification for retention >7 days. Default is 7 days; Legal must sign off for longer. Also confirm exact fields required (avoid full prompts where possible).

Daniel Kim - Security (2026-03-03): Noted. We need to restrict export to named engineers: Marco Hernandez, Lena Ortiz, and Samir Patel. Provide list of principals for ephemeral role. Also require video recording of access session.
Marco Hernandez (2026-03-04): SRE can run export once approvals are in place. Drafted export runbook and access checklist. Will run dry run in staging first and share hash mapping for verification.
Legal (Emma Liu) (2026-03-08): Reviewed scope. Approve 7-day retention and ephemeral access. For retention beyond 7 days, require signed customer consent or legal subpoena.
resolution: Pending approvals applied: Privacy and Legal approved scoped export with 7-day retention (2026-03-08). Security approved approver list and requested recorded access. Next steps: SRE to run scheduled export dry run in staging (Marco) and then run production export during approved maintenance window. Export will use token-hashing and truncated fields. Final delivery and forensic notes to be attached after run.
